s1.where: The empty start screen for a new conversation
s1.expectation: I think this is the starting screen where you type a new question, probably a new chat. Guessing.
s1.cue: Nothing names it. I worked it out from the empty middle, the three suggestions 'Start a voice chat', 'Create an image or sticker', 'Write or edit', and the input field that says 'Ask ChatGPT'.

first_pass.why: There is no title anywhere. The top bar has a three-line button, 'Get Plus' and a speech-bubble icon, none of which says what this screen is. I have to infer the screen from its contents.
first_pass.solution: Put a plain title in the top bar, for example 'New chat'.

test_cases.action: Open the app on your phone (if something else is showing, press the round-arrow home/back only as described below). Before tapping anything, say where you are and what told you. Then tap the three-line button at the top left, tap 'Library', come back with the arrow at the top left, and — if the side panel is showing — tap the dimmed area on the right to close it. Say again where you are.
test_cases.real_if: it is real if, both times, nothing on the page lets you name where you are
test_cases.not_real_if: it is not real if something on the page lets you name it
test_cases.what_happened: The app opened on a page titled 'Images', so I pressed the back arrow. That opened the side panel, and I closed it by tapping the dimmed area. Now I was on the first page: three-line button, 'Get Plus', a speech-bubble icon, 'Create an image or sticker', 'Write or edit', 'Ask ChatGPT'. No title. I only know it is the first page because it is empty. I tapped the three-line button, then 'Library'. The Library page has the title 'Library' at the top. I came back with the arrow, which opened the side panel again, and I closed it with the dimmed area. I was on the same first page, still with no title. Both times nothing on the page let me name it.

s1.closing_comment: The first page still has no title, before or after going to Library and back. I know it is the first page only because it is empty.

s2.where: A message box asking for microphone permission, on top of a voice screen
s2.expectation: I am at a permission message that appeared because I tried to use Voice. Sure about the message, not about the screen behind it.
s2.cue: The dialog text: 'Please enable microphone access in System Settings to use Voice.' and the buttons 'Cancel' and 'Open settings'.

first_pass.why: The dialog says literally what it is and why it is there. The screen behind it has no name, but the dialog tells me what I was trying to do, which is enough for this moment.

s3.where: An image-making section, on the 'Trending' tab
s3.expectation: Some part of the app for making images, with the 'Trending' tab selected. Guessing about the section.
s3.cue: The boxed tabs 'Trending' and 'Templates', with 'Trending' on a grey background. The input field says 'Create image'. The picture cards are labelled 'Sketch', ''80s flashback', 'Stickers', 'Create a caricature'.

first_pass.why: The tabs tell me which list I am on, not which part of the app I am in. 'Trending' is a filter, not a place. Nothing names the section itself. I also do not know what the X next to the tabs closes.
first_pass.solution: Add a title above the tabs that names the section, for example 'Images'.

test_cases.action: Tap the three-line button at the top left, then 'Images'. Before scrolling, say where you are and what told you. Then scroll the pictures down a little, stop, and — without scrolling back — say where you are now.
test_cases.real_if: it is real if, after the small scroll, nothing on screen lets you name the page
test_cases.not_real_if: it is not real if you can still name it from what you see
test_cases.what_happened: Three-line button, then 'Images'. Before scrolling, the top bar said 'Images', centred, with a back arrow. The notice 'Your generated images moved to Library' sat in its own card below the top bar, and below that were 'Trending' and 'Templates'. So before scrolling I could name the page: Images, Trending tab. I scrolled the pictures down a small amount. The 'Images' title left the screen. The notice slid up underneath the back arrow and the clock, so its text is now cut off and overlaps them, exactly as in the pictures I was shown. What was left was the back arrow, the 'Trending' / 'Templates' tabs and the pictures. Nothing named the page any more.

s3.closing_comment: On the phone, the Images page has the title 'Images' in the top bar when I arrive, so I can name it. The picture I was shown did not have it. It is still a problem once I scroll, which is s12 and s13.

test_cases.action: From the app's first page tap the three-line button at the top left. Say which part of the app you are in right now. Tap 'Library'; then tap the arrow at the top left to come back — the side panel opens again. Look at it: does anything on it show you where you just were?
